title: Fun Poke Bowl Cooking Class at a Local Distillery in Houston
includes: A fun, hands-on 2-hour cooking class led by a talented local chef.
All ingredients and cooking tools provided.
Expert instruction, tips and chef secrets you’ll use daily.
An authentic experience hosted at a local public brewery, distillery, craft beer bar or wine bar.

policies: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A local Houston distillery sets the scene for a hands-on poke bowl session that puts fresh ingredients front and center. You’ll learn how to cook fluffy white or brown rice, practice safe knife handling and master different cuts for vegetables and fish. Then comes the star: sushi-grade ahi tuna tossed in a bright soy, ginger and sesame marinade with low-sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, red pepper flakes, green onions and sesame seeds. You’ll finish by assembling your bowl with creamy avocado, crisp cucumber, edamame, carrots and radish. Along the way, you’ll pick up useful techniques for handling raw fish safely and preventing cross-contamination. No culinary background needed, just an appetite for something fresh.
